hero.title: Vote directly — or trust someone who will.
hero.body: Civitas is a platform for direct democracy with optional, per-topic delegation. Verified citizens decide policy together — every tally public, every change reversible, every weight traceable to the person who carried it.
empty.title: No proposals are open for voting right now.
empty.body: Browse the docket to follow what is in deliberation and what has closed.
how.title: How it works
how.step1_body: Verify your email and you become eligible to vote and to take part in structured deliberation. Minimal data, clear retention, easy deletion.
how.step2_body: Every proposal carries its full body and an open thread. Argue, question, and surface the trade-offs before anything is decided.
how.step3_body: Cast a direct vote, or delegate a topic to someone you trust. Tallies report every weight with the chain that carried it.
mechanism.title: A direct vote always wins.
mechanism.body: Delegated weight flows along a chain of trust until it reaches someone who votes directly. Every link is visible. The moment you vote yourself, your weight leaves the chain.
principles.title: What we hold to
principles.sovereignty_body: Users hold real authority over their own votes and delegations — never a recommendation engine deciding for them.
principles.transparency_body: All tallies are publicly verifiable. Every state change is recorded in an append-only audit log.
principles.reversibility_body: Votes can be changed while the window is open; delegations revoked at any time. Nothing you decide is a trap.
principles.capture_body: Licensed AGPL-3.0 to keep the civic commons from corporate enclosure. The code itself supports self-governance.
cta.title: Collective decisions, made legible and reversible.
